home.intro_body: Discover the irresistible kittens from our Geneva Bengal cattery and see why they're so exceptional. You'll see these adorable little felines in all sorts of rare and spectacular colors. Who knows? Maybe you'll find the Bengal kitten of your dreams here!
home.quality_body: Bengal cats and kittens of every color, with a beauty recognized around the world.
home.health_body: Breeding Bengal cats that go through a full testing process to ensure their good health and that of their kittens.
home.temperament_body: Bengal kittens made with love that will win you over with their charming personality and affectionate behavior.
home.montage_alt: Bengal kittens from the Geneva Bengal cattery
home.testimonials_body: We are thrilled to have made so many families happy with their new kittens. Knowing that we manage to bring happiness to so many people touches us deeply. Here are the testimonials from the families and breeders who have adopted one, or even two, cats from Geneva Bengal.
home.shipping_script: Our kittens all over the world
home.shipping_title: Our Bengal kittens have conquered the world!
home.shipping_body: Our magnificent little creatures now live with families or Bengal cat breeders located all over the planet. We take care of all the arrangements for international delivery; all you'll have to do is pick up your new companion at the airport closest to you. We make sure your Bengal kitten travels comfortably from our cattery to you and arrives safely.
home.facebook_body: Follow the adventures of our spectacular Bengal cats and kittens. Get ready for dazzling and truly adorable moments.
